name: Sanskrit as Abhinavagupta practice — full structured pathway
principle: Don't learn Sanskrit merely so you can eventually read Abhinavagupta. Use learning Sanskrit itself as training in Abhinavagupta's model of consciousness.

nyasa_meaning.not: My right shoulder anatomically emits the frequency ka.
nyasa_meaning.is: I am reconstructing this apparently ordinary biological body as the body of Śakti by installing within it the entire matrix from which articulated experience arises.
nyasa_meaning.system_rationale: Totalization — the alphabet a→kṣa fills the body until virtually nothing remains outside it. Head/sensory interface → limbs/action → torso → internal constituents.
nyasa_meaning.caution: Do not invent physiological explanations where the texts don't provide them. Some assignments are inherited ritual correspondences. Abhinavagupta is more interested in what the complete configuration accomplishes.

flood_frame.claim: The tantric body is constructed, not discovered. Tradition is inscribed on body through ritual, yoga, reading. Body becomes text.
flood_frame.caveat: Text-specific, not biomedical anatomy. Process invariance, content particularity. No mixing rites across texts.

multi_identity_phoneme.bruno_use: Dense bundle of relations, not one English gloss.

sadadhvan.name: ṣaḍadhvan — six courses
sadadhvan.flood: For monistic Śaivas these are paired manifestations of consciousness; each path interpenetrates the others.
sadadhvan.implication: Language-space and world-space are two articulations of the same Śakti. Transformations of language = transformations of ontology.

levels_of_speech.vaikharī: actually speaking the verse — breath, tongue, palate, lips, glottis; meter organizes time
levels_of_speech.madhyamā: verse runs internally without audible speech; words, syntax, sequence known
levels_of_speech.paśyantī: differentiation between sound-units and meaning much less developed
levels_of_speech.parā: undifferentiated speech-power prior to articulated subject/object structure

verse_practice.is: encounter verse at progressively deeper resolutions
verse_practice.srsti: awareness → intention/meaning → inner language → articulated Sanskrit → vibrating body/world
verse_practice.samhara: audible verse → silently heard → semantic/intuitive whole → pre-articulated impulse → awareness from which expression arises

matrka_vs_malini.matrka: articulated order — pedagogically useful because Sanskrit phonetic order already has intelligible articulatory architecture
matrka_vs_malini.malini: Śakti's esoteric reconfiguration of that articulated order — different bodily installation; correlates with levels of consciousness and tattvas (PTv)
matrka_vs_malini.rule: Master ordinary varṇamālā first. Once you know a stable coordinate system, you can deliberately permute it.

overlays_not_one_chart.principle: Abhinavagupta does NOT have one canonical anatomical diagram reducing to modern seven-chakra scheme. Multilayered coordinates — different projections of one multidimensional system.
overlays_not_one_chart.ui_rule: Don't make one 2D chakra chart. Make selectable overlays.
overlays_not_one_chart.flood_support: Systems with five knots, nine/eleven wheels, sixteen loci, twenty-eight vital points; six-cakra arrangement is comparatively late.

sensory_goddess_overlay.function: sensory goddesses continually offer their objects to Bhairava
sensory_goddess_overlay.practice_move: Decompose ordinary experience into its powers, then recognize their common source.
sensory_goddess_overlay.example: Ordinary: 'I am here looking at an object over there.' Tantric: the goddess of vision is presenting rūpa to consciousness. Deeper: goddess + seeing + visible thing + Bhairava are modalities of the same consciousness.

chanting_progression.name: namaḥ śivāya as worked example

levels.name: micro-somatic articulation
levels.content: na dental/nasal · ma labial/nasal · ḥ visarga · śi palatal sibilant + vowel

levels.name: auditory
levels.content: simultaneously produce and hear the mantra

levels.name: mātṛkā awareness
levels.content: not merely sounds — manifestations of phonemic Śaktis

levels.name: semantic
levels.content: namaḥ and śiva semantic field directly present, not English dictionary entries

levels.name: internalize
levels.content: spoken → internal sound → felt articulatory intention → preverbal meaning → awareness

chanting_progression.watch: You are watching language be born. And then watching it dissolve.

phonematics.ha: terminal edge of alphabetic manifestation / Śakti

aham_master_key.flood_tā: cosmos emerges from and returns to this absolute I; aham as animating power of mantra
aham_master_key.wheel_rhythm: a…kṣa → Śakti-cakra → aham → pure reflexive awareness → a…kṣa expands again
aham_master_key.practice_guard: Mātṛkā practice should not leave you thinking 'fifty little energies live inside my body.' It should lead toward: all fifty differentiations arise within the single field denoted by aham.

spanda_recursion.spanda: primordial dynamism — consciousness inherently dynamic, source of manifestation (Dyczkowski)
spanda_recursion.laya_reverses: dissolve paths into sustaining deities → body → breath → mind → consciousness
spanda_recursion.scale: same basic recursion at multiple scales

pratyabhijna_endpoint.name: recognition
pratyabhijna_endpoint.claim: The powers you've been invoking and mapping aren't ultimately external mechanisms controlling consciousness. They are expressions of consciousness.
pratyabhijna_endpoint.flood: On recognition of absolute subjectivity, the goddesses animating both body and cosmos are recognized as expansions of one's own consciousness.
arc: recognize it as that same basis

phases.title: Chant phonemes at body points
phases.goal: Install Mātṛkā by voice + touch + locus. Totalization of the mapped body.

phases.title: Articulation instrument + dual coordinates
phases.goal: 5×5 mouth matrix + production/tantric dual locus per phoneme.

phases.title: Levels of speech on one seed / short verse
phases.goal: vaikharī → madhyamā → paśyantī → parā on a controlled text.

phases.title: Ṣaḍadhvan pairing + word/mantra work
phases.goal: varṇa↔kalā, mantra↔tattva, pada↔bhuvana as paired consciousness.

phases.title: Mālinī reconfiguration
phases.goal: After Mātṛkā automatic — permute the stable system.

phases.title: Sandhi as felt transformation + verse resolutions
phases.goal: Grammar as animated transformation; verse at multiple depths.

phases.title: Sensory-deity overlay + Pratyabhijñā recognition
phases.goal: Decompose experience into powers; recognize as consciousness.

goswami_role: TOOL_NOT_BACKBONE — later: fine breath, elemental geometry, bindu-concentration. Natural breath during chanting phases.
